explanation: This poll is listed for the record but is not used in the forecast. Scope Research described its method only briefly: an online survey of people invited by text message, with no account of how respondents were chosen or weighted. Scope has not published earlier polls that can be checked against an election result, so there is no record yet of how accurate its polls are. Scope is also not a member of the Canadian Research Insights Council, the industry body that sets standards for Canadian polling firms.
notes: Decided by the maintainer on 2026-10-08. CRIC non-membership checked by the maintainer against CRIC's member list on 2026-10-08. Scope's earlier releases (2025-02-06 to 2026-08-17) include no election poll that can be scored against a result.
